training: 60% train / 40% audit; remove zero rows before split; fixed public source features; scales from training only, audit clipping counted.
prototype_updates: Lloyd iterations on training only. Early base iteration1 -> 2,4,8,16; mature base8 -> 9,12,16,24. Null and reverse-step diagnostic retained.
basis: Training-only rank63 learned and PCA; nested rank15 prefix at same precision.
decision: Certify strict decrease/increase of exact quantized nearest-center cost from sign of interval; otherwise inconclusive. No coverage threshold.
comparisons: paired change envelope with exact rounded-Gram correction
selection: Proof workloads fixed before this grid; every update proved regardless of native outcome. Exploratory seed0 pilot excluded from confirmation seeds.
replication: Report fit seeds within each dataset/k stratum. Different k, ages, ranks and updates share each dataset/seed split and are dependent; proof counts are execution checks.
claim_boundary: No universal learned superiority or novelty-firstness assumed. Algorithmic benchmark traces are not production deployment traces.
proof_cases: 6 predeclared independent fits x (learned/PCA x rank15/63 + exact Full), plus 2 single-repetition deployment controls and 1 same-input portability control.
portability: Frozen locally prepared MNIST/k3/seed11/early/r63 input, same bytes on Windows and Mobin Linux, 4-CPU caps, paired-only one-repetition workflow; not an additional independent fitted model.
query_timing: First MNIST k3/seed11 family uses 3 query repetitions and 1 warmup; other families use 1 repetition and no warmup. All alternatives within each fit matched. Stage1 once per row.
batches: Common within each fit: MNIST/Fashion4; text k5 batch2; text k10 batch1 for exact Full memory/constraint feasibility.
workflow: Every predeclared update and all original rows proved; absolute and paired alternatives independently publicly replayed. Single-repetition deployment controls measure paired-only and exact Full workflows.
publication_status: Private repository; public release not authorized. Author details delegated to supervisor.
